# Muskaan Singh — Full Site Content

## About Muskaan Singh

Muskaan Singh is a Kolkata-based fashion designer, content creator, and entrepreneur. She is the founder of Label Muskaan Singh and its sub-brand Ibtida. Her work sits at the intersection of Indian craft heritage and contemporary design — building garments that are rooted in tradition but built for modern life.

She is a Key Opinion Leader (KOL) in the Indian fashion and lifestyle space, with over 80,000 followers across Instagram and collaborations with 20+ brands across fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.

## Label Muskaan Singh

Label Muskaan Singh is a contemporary ethnic fashion label founded in 2023. The label specialises in luxury Chikankari — the intricate needlework tradition of Lucknow — applied to modern silhouettes. The philosophy: craft that outlives the season, style that belongs to you.

Available on: labelmuskaansingh.in, Amazon India, Flipkart, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho.

Categories: Sarees, Lehengas, Sharara Sets, Kurta Sets, Co-ords, Kurtis, Gowns, Blazers, Tops, Fusion Wear.

## Ibtida

Ibtida (meaning "a new beginning") is the everyday sub-brand of Label Muskaan Singh, launched in 2025. Where the core label is occasion wear, Ibtida is designed for daily life — accessible, wearable, crafted without compromising on quality.

Instagram: @_ibtidaofficial_

## Content Creation

Muskaan Singh is an active content creator on Instagram across three accounts:
- @muskaansingh97 — personal lifestyle and fashion content
- @labelmuskaansingh — brand content for Label Muskaan Singh
- @_ibtidaofficial_ — brand content for Ibtida

She has collaborated with 20+ brands across fashion, beauty, and lifestyle categories through reels, posts, and stories.

## Press Coverage

Label Muskaan Singh has been featured in Republic India, Daily Hunt, FlipBoard, Indian Bulletin, Indian Sentinel, Abhyuday Times, and RD Times.

## Celebrity Associations

Label Muskaan Singh garments have been worn by: Bhagyashree, Mimi Chakraborty, Ayoshi Talukdar, Madhumita Sarcar, Naina Ganguly, Sauraseni Maitra, Srabanti Gintu Chatterjee, Sanchita Baidya, Sohini Guha Roy, Swastika Ghosh.
